OCR\-assisted complete Burushaski–German dictionary, with source\-positioned OCR and font evidence, image\-reviewed corrections, and explicitly unreviewed machine translations\.
reference.progress: Complete lexical dictionary on printed pp. 9--486. The preface on p. 8, the weaker duplicate scan of pp. 94--95, the proper-name appendix, the German--Burushaski index, and back matter are excluded
reference.provenance: Pinned source scan SHA-256 864cd94f8c41237aae2408e154f7b8d9e21c911b90f7d3ff6dd261568f05c0dc; 300 dpi OCR in data/other/forms/raw_data/berger.py; line-and-column reconstruction, conservative Turner linking, and installation in data/other/forms/raw_data/berger_cleanup.py; English editorial layer data/other/forms/raw_data/20260828-berger-editorial.csv; identity crosswalk data/other/forms/raw_data/20260828-berger-entry-map.csv; audit, seeded review, and manifest data/other/forms/raw_data/20260828-berger-audit.csv.gz, data/other/forms/raw_data/20260828-berger-sample.csv, and data/other/forms/raw_data/20260828-berger-manifest.json; installed rows data/other/forms/20260726-berger-auto.csv; September 2026 repair package data/other/forms/raw_data/berger_2026/ (native font/position snapshot, source-key protection, reviewed readings, translations, complete audit, references, and manifest)

comparisons.evidence: Legacy Jambu data linked the Backstrom Burushaski attestation hɑˈlič̣i ‘turmeric’; hɑˈlɪč̣i ‘turmeric’ to CDIAL 13992 haridrā. Backstrom supplies the lexical attestation; the historical relation and its direction are not asserted here.
